# Amatir Kanya Gurukul

> Amatir Kanya Gurukul is a CBSE girls' boarding school in Kurukshetra, Haryana. The school combines modern education with India's traditional wisdom through academics, life skills, sports, holistic development, and a Gurukul-inspired environment.

## About Amatir

- [About Amatir](https://www.amatir.org/about)
- [Home](https://www.amatir.org/)
- [Contact Amatir](https://www.amatir.org/contact)

Amatir Kanya Gurukul is a girls' residential school located in Bachgaon Gamri, Lukhi Road, Kurukshetra, Haryana. The school provides a residential learning environment that combines modern education with Indian values, discipline, life skills, sports, and holistic development.

## Academics

- [Academics](https://www.amatir.org/academics)

Amatir follows a CBSE-based academic approach designed to develop curiosity, conceptual understanding, practical skills, confidence, and character. The academic program also includes preparation for competitive examinations such as JEE and NEET, along with Olympiads and CUET readiness.

## Gurukul Education

- [Academics and Gurukul Approach](https://www.amatir.org/academics)

The Gurukul approach at Amatir combines academic learning with practices and values that support self-awareness, discipline, inner balance, responsibility, and personal growth.

Key elements include:

- Atma Dhyan
- Sadhana
- Classical Hatha Yoga
- Sewa
- Hawan
- Sandhya
- Inner Engineering
- Spiritual excursions

## Hawan, Sandhya, Meditation and Yoga

- [Gurukul Practices](https://www.amatir.org/academics)

Hawan is a traditional morning practice involving fire offerings and Vedic chanting. Sandhya is an evening prayer practiced by students as part of daily life at the Gurukul.

The school also incorporates meditation and yoga-based practices as part of its holistic educational environment. Classical Hatha Yoga and Atma Dhyan are included in the school's Gurukul approach to support balance, discipline, focus, and inner development.

## Co-Curricular Activities

- [Co-Curricular Activities](https://www.amatir.org/co-curricular)

Students participate in activities beyond academics, including sports, yoga, creative arts, performing arts, leadership development, and NCC.

Sports offered include volleyball, basketball, football, handball, athletics, and taekwondo.

## Boarding and Residential Life

- [Residential School and Campus](https://www.amatir.org/reachout)

Amatir provides an all-girls residential campus designed to give students a supportive and structured living and learning environment.

The school emphasizes discipline, independence, Indian cultural values, personal responsibility, and community living.

## Campus and Facilities

- [Amatir Campus](https://www.amatir.org/reachout)
- [Co-Curricular Activities](https://www.amatir.org/co-curricular)

The Amatir campus covers more than 30 acres and includes academic, residential, sports, and activity spaces designed to support students' overall development.

## Admissions

- [Admissions](https://www.amatir.org/admissions)
- [Request a Call Back]https://www.amatir.org/contactt)

Amatir provides admissions for girls entering its residential school program. Parents can contact the school through the official website for current admission requirements, eligibility, fee information, and the admission process.
